# Kaimoru

> Kaimoru is a full-stack, server-side-rendered e-commerce store built complete for Japan, written in Rust (Axum) with PostgreSQL. It covers domestic payments (KOMOJU and Stripe), consumption-tax classes including the reduced rate, qualified-invoice receipts, a points programme, step mail, and a built-in conversational shopping agent whose proposals enter the cart only with explicit human approval. Dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0.

- [Security policy](https://github.com/BasnetStafan/kaimoru/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability
